summary: Penney Farms fire tower, Clay County FL: an 80-ft tower reported erected by March 1929 for the Black Creek forest association; manned in 1929 and staffed in 1948; current state unknown.

facts.status_note: Reported erected by 1929; no source found says whether the tower still stands.

events.note: Association ordered equipment including an 80-foot tower to be erected at the center of its property (Jacksonville Journal, quoted on Forest Lookouts)
Tower reported erected by March 1929 (Florida Times-Union, quoted on Forest Lookouts)
Manned day and night by one or more men on watch, per the 1929 Times-Union item
A woman and her brother were employed at the tower, per a Bradford County Telegraph item

evidence.supports: Association formed to protect forest property
evidence.quote: Black Creek Forest Protective association was organized in Jacksonville recently

evidence.supports: Equipment ordered to protect property in Clay County
evidence.quote: protect the association's property in Clay county

evidence.supports: 80-foot tower to be erected in the center of the property
evidence.quote: Included is an 80-foot fire tower, which will be erected in the center of the property.

evidence.supports: Tower erected on high ground above 200 feet
evidence.quote: has been erected on an eminence over 200 feet above sea level

evidence.supports: Tower not far from the Penney Farms community center
evidence.quote: Not far from the community center of Penney Farms
manned day and night with one or more men constantly on watch

evidence.supports: Fire-fighters immediately available nearby; tower attendants on their way to fires at a moment's notice
evidence.quote: at a moments notice from the fire-tower attendants are on the way to extinguish fires

evidence.supports: State forest ranger planned for the year
evidence.quote: a state forest ranger is to be employed for the year

evidence.supports: January 1948 family moved to the tower
evidence.quote: moved last week to the fire tower at Penney Farms
where Mrs. Rader and her brother are employed

notes_for_editor: All history comes from three newspaper items quoted secondhand on the Forest Lookouts page (Jacksonville Journal 1928, Florida Times-Union 1929, Bradford County Telegraph 1948). The newspapers themselves were not read. Penney Farms Wikipedia, the Historical Society of Penney Farms site, the Genealogy Village Clay County page and the Clay Today museum articles were checked and do not mention the tower. The record's 24.4 m height matches the 80-foot figure. The firetower.org Florida register lists six sites and none is Penney Farms. The 1948 names are left out of the story as private individuals; the evidence entry keeps the quoted wording. No photos found.
